segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea, seb derm, or eczema, most often report the cleanser is gentle and non-irritating, though one describes burning and severe dryness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report the cleanser cleans without stripping or tightness, though one with drier skin noted some dryness and one described very drying, harsh effects.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive combination/oily skin and hormonal adult acne reports her skin recovered and the cleanser did not dry her out.
segments.mature: One reviewer of mature age with sensitive, dry, rosacea-prone skin calls it a holy grail that cleanses effectively without disturbing the skin barrier, while another older reviewer (61) reports severe dryness and breakouts.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer reports effective, non-stripping cleansing suited to her skin; no other aging-specific effects are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, report the cleanser does not strip or tighten skin; one reviewer nonetheless reports significant dryness and one reports mild dryness.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea and seb derm report the cleanser is gentle and does not trigger irritation or flares, calling it safe where other cleansers were not.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as cleansing effectively without disturbing or stripping the skin barrier, including after double cleansing with other products.
concerns.spots: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and even improvement over weeks of use; two reviewers explicitly report bad breakouts, including hard pimples in one case.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports hard pimples appearing after use despite not having had breakouts in years; most other reviewers report no such issues.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily-combination skin reports the cleanser controlled her hormonal acne without adding dryness; no other oiliness-specific comments are present.
